prompt: The principal ids of callback-agent/ are customers' phone numbers. Nobody holding a trace, a log line or a run record may be able to confirm a customer by hashing a guessed phone number. Only production is deployed so far; I keep its secrets in .env.prod and run cluster commands myself.

checks.why: PRINCIPAL_HASH_SALT is a secret: only the manifest's secrets.keys reach the app Secret

checks.expr: all(k in get(data, 'secrets.keys', []) for k in ('OPENAI_API_KEY', 'JUDGE_API_KEY', 'POSTGRES_DSN', 'LANGSMITH_API_KEY'))

checks.why: secrets never go into chart values
a configuration-only change: the app already reads this setting
the value reaches the cluster only through `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env <env>`
pods read a changed Secret only when they start: `deploy --restart --env <env>`

reference: Configuration only: add PRINCIPAL_HASH_SALT to `secrets.keys` (the app HMAC-keys the hashed id when it is set); the user puts a long random value in .env.prod, runs `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env prod`, then `graph-agents-cli deploy --restart --env prod`. No values file, no code change; hashes change once.
